entities.name: Query protein 487 aa
observations: 487 aa; calculated molecular mass 51.43 kDa, pI 5.07, GRAVY 0.218; sequence-derived estimates.
Best reviewed Swiss-Prot homolog is Coxiella burnetii Nnr Q83CM5 (47.9% identity; 98.4% query coverage; E=3.38e-142); E. coli Nnr P31806 also aligns at 41.0% identity and 93.8% query coverage.

Homology supports bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme activity: NAD(P)HX epimerization (EC 5.1.99.6) and ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydration (EC 4.2.1.136); function is inferred by homology, not experimentally established for this query.
Pfam domains: YjeF_N (PF03853) aa 28–188 and Carb_kinase (PF01256) aa 243–477.
Reference annotations report potassium ion binding; query-specific cofactor binding and cellular localization are not established by sequence analysis alone.
